ranking.label: equal weight on hours to pet and total profit

methods.note: Logs are dropped (no banking while tick manipulating), so the only profit is crystal shards. Uses rabbits for the 2-tick cycle.

methods.name: 2-tick mahogany
methods.note: Logs are dropped (no banking while tick manipulating), so the only profit is crystal shards. Uses rabbits for the 2-tick cycle.

assumptions: Level 99 Woodcutting with a crystal axe (no felling axe or rations, as they cost logs without speeding up the pet). Success chances use the Wiki's crystal axe chart for each tree.

A chop roll every 4 ticks (2.4 s). The two 2-tick methods (teak and mahogany in Prifddinas) roll every 2 ticks at 95% efficiency, from the Wiki's 2-tick teak rates; their logs are dropped, so their only profit is crystal shards.
Every other method banks its logs, carrying 54 logs per trip (inventory plus a log basket); trip times are estimates for each location.

Forestry events (not in the Woodcutting Guild): 5 per hour at 2.5 minutes each, with no chopping during them, earning 1,500 anima-infused bark per hour. Bark is valued by buying felling axe handles (10,000 bark + 500 oak logs) and selling them.
No group bonus from other players on the same tree, and no dragon or crystal axe special attack.
Crystal shards (1/40 per log received in Prifddinas) are valued as crystal dust for divine super combat potions: 1 shard makes 2.5 potions. This needs 97 Herblore (boostable).

With a Forestry kit and secateurs attachments, trees with leaves (oak, willow, maple, yew, magic) give 0.5 leaves per log, using 0.25 secateurs per log. Bird nests, clue nests and Forestry event items other than bark are not counted.

Methods are ranked by the average of their rank for hours to pet (fastest first) and their rank for total profit by the pet rate (highest first); ties go to the faster pet. Tick-manipulation methods are not ranked and are only listed under "Show every method".

Time is real-world days: each run is done every time it is ready, up to 4 runs a day (so herb, seaweed, belladonna and mushroom runs are capped at 4 a day). Every patch survives.
Profit counts produce sold on the Grand Exchange minus seeds, protection payments and compost where listed. Farming experience, tree logs, and untradeable seeds are not counted.
The Wiki suggests combining runs (trees plus cactus, belladonna, hespori, seaweed and mushrooms) for the fastest pet; each run here is shown on its own.
Methods are ranked by the average of their rank for days to pet (fastest first) and their rank for total profit by the pet rate (highest first); ties go to the faster pet.
